services.name: Sail Times
services.desc: Skip the crowded streets, impossible parking, and packed wharves to watch the sky ignite from the tranquility of Newport Harbor. There is no better way to experience the Navy’s “Salute to Summer” than with a front-row seat on a classic sailing yacht. Enjoy breathtaking, unobstructed panoramic views of the season’s most spectacular fireworks display, surrounded by the beauty of the illuminated coastline. Step aboard as the evening cools, setting the perfect stage for a memorable night on Narragansett Bay. blurb: Guests sail aboard three unique boats to experience Newport's harbor and bay. Options include morning, afternoon, sunset sails, and private charters. The company has operated for 37 years and offers a variety of sail types and group sizes.

quotes.author: Bobbi Stewart
quotes.text: Our group of 11 had an amazing experience with Captain Jack and the crew! Not only was the mid-October weather absolutely perfect for our sunset cruise, but the crew kept us laughing with history lessons and great beverage options. Highly Recommend!

quotes.author: David C
quotes.text: We had a great night and the sail was perfect! Really enjoyed the crew and the boat was beautiful. I would recommend this to anyone that sails. Newport is a beautiful place, and we were able to see a great sunset and were treated to a perfect night.

quotes.author: Kara Mercuri
quotes.text: Sailing on the sunset cruise was amazing! Surrounded by beautiful sights and the breathtaking sunset. Our crew Matt, Sean, and Sophie were friendly, knowledgeable, and welcoming. Definitely don’t want to miss this on your trip to Newport!

quotes.author: Antanina
quotes.text: Such an amazing experience, the crew was awesome, Matt the captain, Sofia and Shawn really made those 1.5h memorable. Loved the stories and legends they told us about some sailors, ships, bells on ships and sea overall.

quotes.author: Jodi V
quotes.text: Such a fun boat trip! Friendly crew kept the champagne and drinks flowing. We were lucky to see a gorgeous Sun part of view are spectacular regardless. Highly recommend.

quotes.author: MG
quotes.text: Spent a great evening on the Schooner Aquidneck sunset cruise. The crew was friendly and informative. They give light sightseeing descriptions and would answer any questions you had in between. The sunset cruise provided beer and champagne included in the cost. This ship is also very smooth and quiet with the sails out, I would not worry about sea sickness! You don’t see a ton of things on the trip but it’s a great way to spend an evening just relaxing on the boat and snag some great photos.
